"""Freeze V167 full endpoint review,independent metrics and native rendering."""
import ast
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V167-bounded-support-v1'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);previous=Path(plan['previous'])
old=previous/'postprocess-v2/scripts';post=root/'postprocess-v1/scripts';post.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
for name in ['train_v43_quality_trial.py','report_late_spectral_mixed_quiet.py','profile_raw_kernel_inference.py','report_checkpoint_pilot.py','train_directional_bank_trial.py']:
 shutil.copyfile(old/name,post/name)
shutil.copyfile(Path(plan['work'])/'scripts/review_bounded_support_trial.py',post/'review_bounded_support_trial.py')
for name in ['score','audit','render']:
 s=(old/f'{name}_common_support_routing_trial.py').read_text().replace('_common_support_routing_trial','_bounded_support_trial').replace('V166','V167')
 s=s.replace('Common ctrl raw1k','Routed ctrl raw1k').replace('Common ctrl EMA1k','Routed ctrl EMA1k').replace('Routed common raw1k','Bounded support raw1k').replace('Routed common EMA1k','Bounded support EMA1k')
 s=s.replace('Matched V167 paired control and harmonic context scores','Matched V167 stronger-pair control and routed-common objective scores').replace('Native four-endpoint regional-DC comparisons','Native four-endpoint routed-common objective comparisons')
 s=s.replace('48 fixed boards add5 retained','48 fixed boards add8 retained')
 ast.parse(s);(post/f'{name}_bounded_support_trial.py').write_text(s)
retained=read(previous/'postprocess-plan-v1.json')['retained_native_collections'];assert len(retained)==8
cases=read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')['observations']
for binding in retained.values():
 assert ref(binding['path'])==binding;c=read(binding['path'])
 assert [r['id'] for r in c['observations']]==[v['id'] for v in cases]
 assert all(r['parent']==v['parent'] for r,v in zip(c['observations'],cases,strict=True))
save(root/'native-retained-comparators-v1.json',{'collections':retained,'new_forwards':0,
 'scope':'Eight retained V156raw/V157/V158/V159EMA/V160ordinary+pairedEMA/V161EMA/V162EMA columns. Current control is V166,all822 inputs/parents match. No retained neural forwards.'})
shared=repo/'.cache/quality-20261103';metrics=[shared/'collaborative-detail-v1/transfer-v1.py',shared/'collaborative-detail-v1/audit-transfer-v1.py',shared/'V144-V145-photo-supplement-v1/operator-v2.py']
env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=':'.join(str(p) for p in [post,Path(plan['work'])/'scripts',Path(plan['work'])/'src']),OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1')
command='from pathlib import Path;from score_bounded_support_trial import load_module;'+f'r=Path({str(shared)!r});'
command+='load_module(r/"collaborative-detail-v1/transfer-v1.py","errors");load_module(r/"collaborative-detail-v1/audit-transfer-v1.py","independent_late_spectral_metrics");load_module(r/"V144-V145-photo-supplement-v1/operator-v2.py","photos");'
command+='import review_bounded_support_trial,audit_bounded_support_trial,render_bounded_support_trial;print("PASS actual V167 reviewer/independent metrics/render imports")'
run=subprocess.run([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-c',command],cwd=repo,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True);assert run.returncode==0,(run.stdout,run.stderr)
save(root/'postprocess-import-preflight-v1.json',{'returncode':run.returncode,'stdout':run.stdout,'stderr':run.stderr,'command':command,
 'metrics':[ref(p) for p in metrics],'retained_native_collections':retained,'sources':{str(p):ref(p)['sha256'] for p in post.glob('*.py')},
 'new_forwards':0,'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
print('Frozen9 postprocess sources/eight retained columns/822cases/72native images')
